sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with 3 objects (livre, table, Terre); student
selects a system boundary (dashed lasso) and the app labels forces as
intérieures/extérieures, and pairs Newton's 3rd-law couples with
colored arrows across the boundary. Advance after 2 boundary choices
explored. Experiment: 3 seeded scenes; student picks correct system
to isolate a target force. Evaluate: arrows hidden; student draws
action-reaction pairs by connecting dots between labelled objects.
Wrinkle: emphasises "système" as a chosen abstraction, not a given.
